Ambassador,Ⓒs.ⒹdUtaH, rAjadUtaH, praRiDiH, saMdeSaharaH.

Ambient,Ⓒa.ⒹvyApaka; nipAtin, gAmin in comp.
Ⓑ
 2 vezwaka, parivezwaka.

Ambiguous,Ⓒa.ⒹdvyarTa, saMdigDArTa, avyakta, aspazwa, saMdigDa.
Ⓝ[Ambiguous]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹaspazwaM, vakroktyA, dvyarTataH.
Ⓝ[Ambiguous]ness, Ambiguity,Ⓒs.Ⓓvakrokti f., saMdigDArTatA, saMdehArTaH.

Ambition,Ⓒs.ⒹspfhA, AkAMkzA.
Ⓑ
 2 kIrtispfhA, ESvaryAkAMkzA, uccapadavAMCA; ‘a(mbition) to get a throne’, rAjyaloBaH-tfzRA.
ⓃAmbitious,Ⓒa.Ⓓsaspfha, sAkAMkza, ESvaryaprepsu, yaSaskAma; ‘who, a(mbitous) of your throne, has roused your envy’ kenAByasUyA padakAMkziRA te janitA (K. iii. 4).
Ⓑ
 2 (Of hopes) dUrADirohin, utsarpin.
Ⓝ[Ambitious]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹESvaryAkAMkza-yA &c.

Ⓔs.ⒹDoritaM.
Ⓝ[Ambl]er,Ⓒs.ⒹDoritagAmin m.

Ambrosia,Ⓒs.ⒹamftaM, suDA, pIyUzaM.
Ⓝ[Ambrosi]al,Ⓒa.Ⓓamftamaya (yI f.), amftatulya, (s.) in comp.

Ambulate,Ⓒv. i.Ⓓvicar 1 P, parikam 1 U, 4 P, itastataScar.
Ⓝ[Ambulat]ion,Ⓒs.ⒹparikramaH, paryawanaM.
Ambush, Ambuscade,Ⓒs.Ⓓ(parAvaskaMdanArTaM) niBfte sTAnaM; niBftAvasTiti f.; ‘they all lay in a(mbush)’ sarva eva te niBftaM tasTuH.
